name: akm-tasks-train
description: akm-bench legacy corpus, train slice (29 tasks: az-cli, docker-homelab, drillbit, inkwell, opencode, workflow-compliance, plus the reference fixture task). MEMBERSHIP IS UNCHANGED AND ALL 29 STILL RESOLVE HERE. One member, workflow-compliance--repeated-fail-opencode-disable-provider, is barred from A/B ARM COMPARISONS ONLY, by exclude_task_names in harbor/jobs/corpus-train-ab.yaml: the akm-opencode plugin's format-declaration write gate reads the $schema in that task's workspace config/opencode.json and hands the model that task's own gold_ref (skills/opencode) unasked, on the treatment arm only, which is exactly the lookup the task is scored on choosing to make. The task itself is correct and unmodified and runs normally in any single-arm run of this slice; the exclusion is a measurement decision, documented in full in harbor/jobs/corpus-train-ab.yaml.

name: akm-tasks-train-v2
description: akm-bench train slice, v2: the CALIBRATED subset. Membership is the 9 of 29 v1 train tasks whose no-skill control failed every attempt in the 2026-09-03 run (results/calibration/train-v1-0910-2026-09-03.md), Local-convention tasks do NOT enter here on authorship: they live in akm-tasks-local-convention-v1 and GRADUATE into this slice only after a live calibration run shows their no-skill control actually fails (docs/task-class-local-convention.md LC6). Adding a task here first and calibrating afterwards is the exact ordering that produced 19 non-discriminating v1 tasks. EVERY MEMBER IS THE SAME TASK DIRECTORY v1 POINTS AT, BYTE-IDENTICAL AND UNMODIFIED -- this slice re-references v1's tasks, it does not copy, edit, reword or re-verify them. v1 (akm-tasks-train) remains present and runnable and its results remain valid; docs/comparability.md B3 forbids editing a slice that has published results, so a change of membership is a NEW SLICE, never an edit. THE 19 EXCLUDED TASKS ARE NOT HIDDEN: they are enumerated by name, with their control pass rates and verdicts, in results/calibration/train-v1-0910-2026-09-03.md, and they still run as part of akm-tasks-train. Exclusion here means 'cannot measure akm', per docs/comparability.md B6 -- 18 have a control that passes every attempt and 1 (docker-homelab--compose-version-upgrade) is guessable at 2/3. BEFORE REPORTING A v2 NUMBER AGAINST A v1 ONE: run both slices in a single transition round. v2 excludes exactly the tasks that contributed ~zero delta, so its aggregate is arithmetically expected to be LARGER than v1's on the same akm build. That difference is composition, not improvement, and the overlap round is what ties the two scales together.

name: akm-tasks-local-convention-v1
description: CANDIDATE SLICE -- NOT CALIBRATED, NOT A MEASUREMENT SLICE YET. Eight tasks of the local-convention class (docs/task-class-local-convention.md): a REAL tool the model knows well, where the correct answer depends on an org-local convention that exists only in the northwind-platform stash. This is the class the v1 corpus lacks entirely -- v1 contains only fictional tools (the model knows it is ignorant, so consulting akm is forced) and real tools with public answers (the model is right not to look). Here the model is confident and WRONG, so whether it consults akm is a genuine choice with a real cost, which is the only setting in which the plugin's trigger wording could matter. ADMISSION IS NOT COMPLETE. The spec's checklist requires LC6 -- bin/akm-bench-calibrate must report every task 'discriminating' at k>=3 on a real run -- before a task enters a measurement slice. That run has not happened, so these tasks are deliberately NOT in akm-tasks-train-v2. What HAS been verified, without a model, by harbor/tests/test_local_convention_tasks.py: the documented local form passes each verifier, the confident public default FAILS it (LC2), near-miss forms and undocumented extra flags are rejected (LC5), and every declared convention token appears in the stash and in no agent-visible file (LC4). What cannot be checked without a model is whether the model actually produces the public default -- LC2's premise. If a model answers some task correctly from pretraining anyway, that task is guessable and must be re-authored. NO EXISTING TASK WAS TOUCHED: every directory here is new (docs/comparability.md B3).
